ContentElement.description: A node of the full format's element tree: the rendered element with its property values merged into one flat map. Key order on the wire is `id`, `component`, `properties`, `slots`, `style`, with `apiAlias` last at every depth.

id.description: Unique element identifier, carried through from the stored element.

component.description: Element component type (e.g. Sw:Grid:Container, Sw:Content:Text, Sw:Product:Card).

properties.description: Element properties keyed by property name, always present. The map draws no distinction between a statically authored value, a value a data loader produced and a value delivered by context. An empty map is serialized as `[]` (consistent with Shopware's JSON-map fields).

oneOf.description: The empty properties map, serialized as `[]`.

slots.description: Child element subtrees keyed by slot name. Each slot name maps DIRECTLY to an ordered list of child elements — there is no wrapper object and no per-slot alias. Omitted entirely when the element has no slots, never serialized as an empty container.

style.description: Universal presentation options keyed by option wire name. Each value is either a single scalar (a flat option) or an object keyed by breakpoint (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl) for a breakpoint-aware option, per the option's breakpointAware flag in the style-option introspection schema. Omitted when empty.

apiAlias.description: Present on every node at every depth, written last.
